component.name: OccluView
component.summary: Fast 3D mesh viewer for dental scans

description.p: OccluView opens dental scans and common mesh files in a native desktop viewport built for the daily work of a CAD designer: orthographic orbit and pan, a cut view, a surface ruler, and a thickness analyser.

Scans load as layers with their own visibility, opacity, tint, and wireframe. Selections are made by click, rectangle, or lasso, and the mesh editor can delete, crop, cut, separate, close holes, repair, and smooth, with undo and redo throughout. Two scans can be aligned against each other and compared through a discrepancy heatmap. Edited layers export back to STL, PLY, or OBJ.

STL, PLY, OBJ, GLB, and HPS dental containers are supported. The package registers the file types with the desktop and installs a thumbnailer, so scans get real previews in the file manager, along with occluview-cli for headless thumbnails and conversion.
